## What changes / 改了什么

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. / 说明用户遇到的问题与修改后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

List relevant checks and actual results. For UI changes, include a screenshot in both languages.
列出相关检查与实际结果；界面修改请提供中英文截图。

For model changes, link a reproducible comparison on an appropriate frozen suite, with model/runtime versions and hardware. Report
regressions as well as improvements; do not tune on the confirmation split.
模型修改请链接冻结测试集的可复现实验，同时报告退化，不在确认集上调参。
